cluster.description: Cluster defines the name of the cluster that ArgoCD is deployed into -- if not provided this will default to 'loft-cluster'.

enabled.description: Enabled indicates if the ArgoCD Integration is enabled for the project -- this knob only enables the syncing of virtualclusters, but does not enable SSO integration or project creation (see subsequent spec sections!).

namespace.description: Namespace defines the namespace in which ArgoCD is running in the cluster.

virtual_cluster_instance.description: VirtualClusterInstance defines the name of *virtual cluster* (instance) that ArgoCD is deployed into. If provided, Cluster will be ignored and Loft will assume that ArgoCD is running in the specified virtual cluster.

enabled.description: Enabled indicates if the ArgoCD Project Integration is enabled for this project. Enabling this will cause Loft to create an appProject in ArgoCD that is associated with the Loft Project. When Project integration is enabled Loft will override the default assigned role set in the SSO integration spec.

source_repos.description: SourceRepos is a list of source repositories to attach/allow on the project, if not specified will be "*" indicating all source repositories.

description.description: Description to add to the ArgoCD project.

block.description: Metadata defines additional metadata to attach to the loft created project in ArgoCD.

description.description: Description to add to the ArgoCD project.

groups.description: Groups is a list of OIDC group names to bind to the role.

name.description: Name of the ArgoCD role to attach to the project.

application.description: Application is the ArgoCD project/repository to apply the rule to.

permission.description: Allow applies the "allow" permission to the rule, if allow is not set, the permission will always be set to "deny".

block.description: Rules ist a list of policy rules to attach to the role.

Roles is a list of roles that should be attached to the ArgoCD project. If roles are provided no loft default roles will be set. If no roles are provided *and* SSO is enabled, loft will configure sane default values.
Project defines project related values for the ArgoCD Integration. Enabling Project integration will cause Loft to generate and manage an ArgoCD appProject that corresponds to the Loft Project.

assigned_roles.description: AssignedRoles is a list of roles to assign for users who authenticate via Loft -- by default this will be the `read-only` role. If any roles are provided this will override the default setting.

enabled.description: Enabled indicates if the ArgoCD SSO Integration is enabled for this project. Enabling this will cause Loft to configure SSO authentication via Loft in ArgoCD. If Projects are *not* enabled, all users associated with this Project will be assigned either the 'read-only' (default) role, *or* the roles set under the AssignedRoles field.

host.description: Host defines the ArgoCD host address that will be used for OIDC authentication between loft and ArgoCD. If not specified OIDC integration will be skipped, but vclusters/spaces will still be synced to ArgoCD.

block.description: SSO defines single-sign-on related values for the ArgoCD Integration. Enabling SSO will allow users to authenticate to ArgoCD via Loft.

generation.description: A sequence number representing a specific generation of the desired state.

labels.description: Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) the VirtualClusterInstance. May match selectors of replication controllers and services. More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/labels

name.description: Name of the VirtualClusterInstance, must be unique. Cannot be updated. More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/identifiers#names

namespace.description:
Namespace defines the space within which each name must be unique. An empty namespace is equivalent to the "default" namespace, but "default" is the canonical representation. Not all objects are required to be scoped to a namespace - the value of this field for those objects will be empty.

Must be a DNS_LABEL. Cannot be updated. More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/namespaces

resource_version.description: An opaque value that represents the internal version of this VirtualClusterInstance that can be used by clients to determine when VirtualClusterInstance has changed. Read more: https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#concurrency-control-and-consistency

uid.description: The unique in time and space value for this VirtualClusterInstance. More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/identifiers#uids

block.description: Standard VirtualClusterInstance's metadata. More info: https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#metadata
VirtualClusterInstance holds the VirtualClusterInstance information

cluster.description: The cluster to list virtual_clusters from.

namespace.description: The namespace to list virtual_clusters from.

block.description: The `loft_virtual_clusters` data source provides information about all virtual clusters that match the given `cluster` and `namespace`.
